title: It works!
body:
This App has evolved so much over the last couple of years since I last used it.

They’ve done amazing iOS integrations and made everything super slick.

Looking forward to going on my health and wellness journey after 3 years since I picked up and injury and just lost focus between raising our young kids and changing jobs everything just went out the window.

Streaks really works and gives that internal reward feeling when you do well.

author: dugstar2020

title: Too simplified
body: Very simple - which can be a plus. BUT... impossible to change previous day record ( in my case it was the amount of sugar in my diet, which I only check next day). The habits descriptors are not linked to the Ihealth app ( same example with sugar- it’s calculated in I health, but not passed to steakes). They are not even linked to a compatible streak workout. So, when I complete it the habit descriptor is not checked out. I can describe many similar examples. So, it’s more like check list. You can get a free app for this. But if you paid almost 10 backs for a bundle - you should expect more functionality.

title: Love it for personal development!
body: Really love this app. I have tried many times to make little improvements in my life but always aimed for too many changes at once, got overwhelmed and gave up. I've been trying to get over a relationship and look after myself better in the process and this app helps keeps me on track each day!
author: Vyvy101

title: Easy to use and clever
body:
Streaks is an easy to use habit tracker that works with you to help you build the habits you want. When setting up a new habit you can choose from presents, some of which feed into the Health app, or create your own, in that case Streaks will look at the habit name and try to find an appropriate icon. It's a small thing that saves you some time.

It has all the features you want from a habit tracker except for support for habits that require multiple action in a day, like drinking water. Then again none of the trackers I've tried have that. Highly recommended.
